name: Poggio Renatico (Italy)
description: Maroon field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Poggio Renatico (red and yellow bars and a tower on a hill) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Poggio Renatico, a comune in Emilia-Romagna; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Poggio Renatico arms — red and yellow bars and a tower on a hill, crowned, within branches
